FLUVIAL_COLLUVIAL.finding: Global native deposit polygons and process classes are available; temporal age is present only where source mapping supplies it and the locally bound DBF has no temporal fields, so formation/event binding remains unresolved for ARCANA.

COASTAL_MARINE.finding: Existing shoreline authority is eligibility-only; research found no single global machine-readable deposit chronology that supplies material identity plus persistence/removal.

LACUSTRINE.finding: Dated lake-sediment/core records are available, but they are study/site records rather than a global deposit-footprint authority.

GLACIAL_OR_GLACIOFLUVIAL.finding: DATED-1 supplies dated ice-margin evidence and uncertainty bounds; it does not by itself authorize surviving glacial or glaciofluvial deposit identity.

TRANSPORTED_AEOLIAN.finding: GUM supplies global aeolian spatial classes and NCEI supplies dated loess study records; no single global footprint-plus-persistence chronology was verified.

ORGANIC.finding: Global peat basal ages and dated core records can constrain formation/initiation at sampled sites; spatial coverage and removal/persistence remain incomplete.

EVAPORITIC.finding: No global machine-readable provider satisfying deposit identity, dated formation, spatial footprint, and preservation/removal semantics was verified.

PYROCLASTIC.finding: GVP supplies dated eruption events and locations, but cell binding still requires source-unit/tephra footprint evidence for the specific ARCANA cell.

multi_domain_finding: GUM is the only researched global multi-branch spatial candidate, but its temporal attributes are source-dependent and the ARCANA-bound local DBF exposes no temporal fields; it cannot be promoted to a complete temporal provider.
